title: DR1's "View details" opens the address's own record page in the address book; the frontend's expands the same three lines that are already in the row.

finding.frontend: The last cell of every picker row is a `<details>` disclosure whose summary reads "View details", with a visually hidden " for <name>", and which expands to a list of the address lines (src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/addresses/party-picker/_address-picker.njk:26-41). Those are the same lines the Address and Country columns already show two cells to the left, so opening it tells the trader nothing they could not already read — there is no contact name, no phone number, no email, no record history and no way to see which other notifications use the record. fe-address-picker-place-of-origin renders the disclosure triangle in every row.
finding.prototype: The same cell in DR1 is a link, not a disclosure: "View details" goes to the address book's record page for that address, carrying a return path back to the picker (app/views/consignment-address-select.html:152, href built at app/routes.js:3562). The trader leaves the picker, reads the whole record and comes back to the same role with their place kept.
finding.difference: Make "View details" a link to the address record rather than an in-page expander, and either drop the address lines from the row or keep them and drop the disclosure — today the picker renders the same lines twice. This service has no address record page and cannot grow one on its own: it reads the address book and never writes it, and the record pages belong to the INS front-door (src/server/app/services/address-book/index.js:17-19). So the work is a cross-app link with a return path, which is the same dependency as adding an address from the picker; the two should be settled together. If the ruling is that this service keeps its own read-only record view, that is a page to add here instead.
finding.falsifiedBy: An address record route existing in trade-imports-animals-frontend, or the frontend disclosure showing any field the row does not already show.

relatedTo.why: both are journeys out of the picker into the address book and share one decision about which service owns address records
